实现DSH浏览器语音输入输出与桥接播放，声学模型/数字人/QQ发送和Agent继承外部栈。见 [Q04](#research-q04)。
首回复baseline跳过、QQ历史/断线无ack且关推送不断入站；录音在途/无声缓冲、全局DH归属与停止门控缺口。见 [Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)。

technical.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)worklet和模型栈有明确继承，常规语音桥接novelty0。端点/逐句排队/DH组合局部机制25%，[Q01](#research-q01)首回复与[Q03](#research-q03)取消不突破关键限制不足50%。Web会话语音适配可借鉴transferability25%，强绑Host节点/外桥，直接系统听写更通用不达50%。组合多通道少人工搬运simplification25%，多服务与全局状态使其不足50%。

business.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)同用户同Agent任务未改变组织/分工/责任workflow0；[Q01](#research-q01)文本变可朗读音频/视频使交付形态局部变化delivery25%，不达50%因未形成不同可验工作成果且停用/漏播。没有明确此前受限群体与可用性依据reach0，不能以低门槛推断无障碍准入；自托管供给/计价/服务责任未变economics0，不用未知GPU费代替结构判断。

recommendation.reason: 已有自托管语音环境的开发者可先在隔离浏览器与虚构数据中审桥合同。它把录音和回复接到 DSH，但 QQ 入站、历史转发及停止竞态尚未通过验收。若桥身份或关闭后仍发送无法界定，应断开桥与 QQ，回键盘文字及独立听写朗读。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)说话/听回复与正确会话判据明确50%，超偶发入口25%；[Q04](#research-q04)多服务负担下重复需求缺实据，不达75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)会话接线/句流比独立搬运有机制增量50%，超过入口25%；首回复跳过、[Q02](#research-q02)QQ归属与[Q03](#research-q03)停止缺口阻75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)到[Q04](#research-q04)核心浏览器接线/失败/依赖直接覆盖50%，超过局部片段25%；外桥与Host未运行，不达75%，作者实测不当独立通过。

cost.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)和[Q03](#research-q03)双向外发及停止/回执有重要缺口，[Q04](#research-q04)多GPU/账号服务需自行维护，25%；可断桥回文字故非0，但无法核清在途与外桥数据故不达50%。

      "content": "// voice-ai-girlfriend build: esbuild browser bundle shaped like the DSH\n// client plugin artifact (lib/client.js, __ModuleLoader__ closure). All\n// @deepseek-ai / react imports stay external — the DSH host provides them.\n//\n// CSS modules: dsh (rc.8, 0.1.3 and the 0.2.x web plugin system alike) does NOT\n// auto-load css sidecars. Every client plugin must inject its own <style\n// data-plugin data-plugin-css> tags (hashed class names). This build therefore\n// compiles *.module.css into (a) a local->hashed class map for the TSX and (b)\n// an injected <style> per css module. A server/node entry (lib/index.js) is also\n// emitted so the dsh loader can import the profile entry on every supported\n// release.\nimport { build } from 'esbuild'\nimport { mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { createHash } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { basename, dirname } from 'node:path'\n\nconst PKG_ID = '@beiyege-01/dsh-voice-ai-girlfriend'\n\nconst EXTERNALS = [\n  'react',\n  'react/jsx-runtime',\n  'react-dom',\n  'react-dom/client',\n  '@deepseek-ai/cordis',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives',\n  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-react',\n]\n\n/** dsh-compatible CSS-modules loader: hashes class names, injects <style>. */\nconst dshCssModules = {\n  name: 'dsh-css-modules',\n  setup(build) {\n    build.onLoad({ filter: /\\.css$/, namespace: 'file' }, async (args) => {\n      const raw = readFileSync(args.path, 'utf8').replace(/\\/\\*[\\s\\S]*?\\*\\//g, '')\n      const tagId = `${PKG_ID}/${basename(args.path)}`\n      const map = {}\n      const css = raw.replace(/\\.([_a-zA-Z][\\w-]*)/g, (match, name) => {\n        if (map[name] === undefined) {\n          const hash = createHash('md5').update(`${args.path}:${name}`).digest('hex').slice(0, 6)\n          // CSS identifiers cannot start with a digit; an md5 hex hash often\n          // does (e.g. 6d13ea), which silently drops the whole rule. Ensure the\n          // leading char is a letter so every scoped class is a valid selector.\n          const safeHash = /^[0-9]/.test(hash) ? `a${hash}` : hash\n          map[name] = `${safeHash}_${name}`\n        }\n        return `.${map[name]}`\n      })\n      const js = [\n        `const css = ${JSON.stringify(css)};`,\n        `const tagId = ${JSON.stringify(tagId)};`,\n        `if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {`,\n        `  const q = 'style[data-plugin-css=' + JSON.stringify(tagId) + ']';`,\n        `  if (!document.querySelector(q)) {`,\n        `    const el = document.createElement('style');`,\n        `    el.dataset.plugin = ${JSON.stringify(PKG_ID)};`,\n        `    el.dataset.pluginCss = tagId;`,\n        `    el.textContent = css;`,\n        `    document.head.appendChild(el);`,\n        `  }`,\n        `}`,\n        `export default ${JSON.stringify(map)};`,\n      ].join('\\n')\n      return { contents: js, loader: 'js', resolveDir: dirname(args.path) }\n    })\n  },\n}\n\nmkdirSync('lib', { recursive: true })\n\n// Server/node half: a deliberate no-op (browser logic lives in client), but\n// the module must EXIST so `dsh` can import the entry when composing the tree.\nawait build({\n  entryPoints: ['src/index.ts'],\n  outfile: 'lib/index.js',\n  bundle: false,\n  format: 'esm',\n  platform: 'node',\n  logLevel: 'info',\n})\n\nawait build({\n  entryPoints: ['src/client/index.ts'],\n  outfile: 'lib/client.js',\n  bundle: true,\n  format: 'cjs',\n  platform: 'browser',\n  jsx: 'automatic',\n  external: EXTERNALS,\n  plugins: [dshCssModules],\n  banner: {\n    js:\n      `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id: ${JSON.stringify(PKG_ID)}, factory: (require) => {\\n` +\n      'var module = { exports: {} }; var exports = module.exports;',\n  },\n  footer: {\n    js: 'return module.exports; } });',\n  },\n  logLevel: 'info',\n})\n\nconsole.log('[voice-ai-girlfriend] build done: lib/index.js + lib/client.js')\n"

      "content": "/**\n * BalanceBadge (composer stats pill): shows the DeepSeek API balance in the\n * composer's bottom stats row.\n *\n * dsh 0.2.x renders `conversation.composer.dock` as the official stats pill\n * row (activity / usage / …), so this entry renders its own compact pill\n * instead of feeding a harness-side stats-extras registry. That registry was a\n * local stats-line patch on the 0.1.3-era checkout; the official 0.2.x tree\n * has no such seam, which made the old \"renders null + window global\" version\n * invisible. A real pill works on every official build, needs no harness\n * patch, and is click-to-refresh.\n *\n * Cost: fetches /api/balance on mount, then every 10 minutes (the bridge\n * caches the upstream answer for 10 minutes, so the official API is hit at\n * most once per 10 minutes).\n */\nimport { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'\nimport type { PropsLocale, PropsRuntime } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\n// Type-only: pulls ui-conversation's SlotMap merge for PropsRuntime resolution.\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client'\nimport type { VoiceInjected } from './contract.ts'\nimport { bridgeBase } from './bridge.ts'\nimport css from './BalanceBadge.module.css'\n\ninterface BalanceInfo {\n  currency: string\n  total_balance: string\n  granted_balance: string\n  topped_up_balance: string\n}\n\ninterface BalanceResp {\n  is_available?: boolean\n  balance_infos?: BalanceInfo[]\n}\n\n/** Format the first (CNY/USD) balance as \"¥xx.xx\" / \"$xx.xx\". */\nfunction formatBalance(body: BalanceResp): string | null {\n  const info = body.balance_infos?.[0]\n  if (info === undefined) return null\n  const value = Number.parseFloat(info.total_balance)\n  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return null\n  const symbol = info.currency === 'USD' ? '$' : '¥'\n  return `${symbol}${value.toFixed(2)}`\n}\n\nconst REFRESH_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000 // aligned with the bridge's 10-min cache\n\n/** Full props: framework runtime share (composer.dock) + locale seat + face. */\nexport type BalanceBadgeProps =\n  PropsRuntime<'conversation.composer.dock'> & PropsLocale<'voice'> & VoiceInjected\n\n/**\n * @param props - framework runtime + locale seats.\n */\nexport const BalanceBadge = memo(function BalanceBadge(_props: BalanceBadgeProps) {\n  const [label, setLabel] = useState<string | null>(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const aliveRef = useRef(true)\n\n  const load = useCallback(async () => {\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch(`${bridgeBase()}/api/balance`)\n      if (!resp.ok) return\n      const json = (await resp.json()) as BalanceResp\n      if (aliveRef.current) setLabel(formatBalance(json))\n    } catch {\n      // Bridge offline: keep the previous value; the next tick retries.\n    } finally {\n      if (aliveRef.current) setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }, [])\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    aliveRef.current = true\n    void load()\n    const timer = window.setInterval(() => { void load() }, REFRESH_MS)\n    return () => {\n      aliveRef.current = false\n      window.clearInterval(timer)\n    }\n  }, [load])\n\n  // Nothing to show before the first successful fetch; stay out of the row.\n  if (label === null) return null\n\n  return (\n    <button\n      type=\"button\"\n      className={css.chip}\n      title={`DeepSeek 余额 ${label}（点击刷新）`}\n      aria-label={`DeepSeek 余额 ${label}，点击刷新`}\n      onClick={() => { void load() }}\n      disabled={loading}\n    >\n      余额 {label}\n    </button>\n  )\n})\n"
    },

ON (default): replies go to the bridge's video\n * pipeline; OFF: fall back to near-instant sentence TTS. The flip is also\n * pushed to the BRIDGE (POST /api/dh/enable) so it stops warming up /\n * submitting to DUIX — the bridge side used to keep hammering DUIX even with\n * this switch off.\n */\nimport { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'\nimport type { PropsLocale, PropsRuntime } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\n// Type-only: pulls ui-conversation's SlotMap merge for PropsRuntime resolution.\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client'\nimport type { VoiceInjected } from './contract.ts'\nimport { dhEnable, dhStatus, notifyDhChanged } from './bridge.ts'\nimport { chipStyle, chipKey } from './chip.ts'\nimport chips from './chips.css'\n\nconst DIGITAL_HUMAN_KEY = 's2s.voice.digitalHuman'\n\nexport function readDigitalHuman(): boolean {\n  try {\n    return localStorage.getItem(DIGITAL_HUMAN_KEY) !== '0'\n  } catch {\n    return true\n  }\n}\n\n/** Full toggle props: framework runtime share + `voice` strokeLinejoin=\"round\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <circle cx=\"12\" cy=\"7\" r=\"3.5\" />\n      <path d=\"M5.5 20a6.5 6.5 0 0 1 13 0\" />\n      <path d=\"M3 3.5 4.6 5M21 3.5 19.4 5M2 10H1M23 // Mount: push the persisted choice to the bridge, so a reload never leaves\n  // the two sides disagreeing (e.g. bridge left ON while this switch is OFF).\n  useEffect(() => {\n    void dhEnable(readDigitalHuman()).then(() => notifyDhChanged())\n  }, [])\n\n  // 生成中 → 按钮周期性绿光：轮询桥接状态（4s，与 companion 同频），只要\n  // DUIX 那边有活在干（合成中 / 生成中 / 有排队）就点亮。\n  const [busy, setBusy] =       "path": "src/client/MicButton.tsx",
      "content": "/**\n * Mic control for the composer tool row (`conversation.input.left`).\n *\n * Continuous listening mode: click once to start a MicRecorder (mic-capture\n * worklet + 1800 ms silence endpointing); every silence-endpointed utterance\n * is queued, sent to the bridge /api/stt, and injected into the conversation\n * via `sendText` — serially, one at a time. Listening stays active until the\n * user clicks again (which stops the recorder and drops queued utterances).\n * Starting capture barges in on any reply being read aloud.\n */\nimport { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'\nimport type { PropsLocale, PropsRuntime } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'\n// Type-only: pulls ui-conversation's SlotMap merge for PropsRuntime resolution.\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client'\nimport { stt, VadStream } from './bridge.ts'\nimport type { VoiceInjected } from './contract.ts'\nimport { MicRecorder } from './voice/recorder.ts'\nimport css from './MicButton.module.css'\nimport chips from './chips.css'\n\n/** Full mic-control props: framework runtime share + `voice` locale seat + injected sendText. */\nexport type MicButtonProps = PropsRuntime<'conversation.input.left'> & PropsLocale<'voice'> & VoiceInjected\n\ntype Phase = 'idle' | 'listening' | 'transcribing' | 'error'\n\n/** Mic glyph (inline, follows currentColor). */\nfunction MicIcon() {\n  return (\n    <svg width=\"16\" height=\"16\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"currentColor\" strokeWidth=\"2\" strokeLinecap=\"round\" strokeLinejoin=\"round\" aria-hidden=\"true\">\n      <path d=\"M12 1a3 3 0 0 0-3 3v8a3 3 0 0 0 6 0V4a3 3 0 0 0-3-3z\" />\n      <path d=\"M19 10v2a7 7 0 0 1-14 0v-2\" />\n      <line x1=\"12\" y1=\"19\" x2=\"12\" y2=\"23\" />\n      <line x1=\"8\" y1=\"23\" x2=\"16\" y2=\"23\" />\n    </svg>\n  )\n}\n\n/**\n * @param props - framework runtime + locale seats + injected sendText/speaker.\n */\nexport const MicButton = memo(function MicButton({ t, sendText, speaker, interruptReply }: MicButtonProps) {\n  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('idle')\n  // Recording state: true while the mic hears speech (driven by the recorder's\n  // onSpeakingChange — flips only, no per-chunk re-renders).\n  const [voiceActive, setVoiceActive] = useState(false)\n  const recorderRef = useRef<MicRecorder | null>(null)\n  const queueRef = useRef<ArrayBuffer[]>([])\n  const drainRunningRef = useRef(false)\n\n  // Release the mic if the control unmounts mid-capture.\n  useEffect(() => () => {\n    recorderRef.current?.stop()\n    recorderRef.current = null\n  }, [])\n\n  // Barge-in listening during reply playback: while the speaker is reading,\n  // the recorder drops chunks (TTS echo never forms an utterance) but keeps\n  // watching the level — sustained speech fires onSpeechInterrupt → the reply\n  // is stopped and the user's ongoing speech becomes the next utterance.\n  // The browser AEC (echoCancellation) keeps the TTS out of the mic signal.\n  useEffect(() => {\n    return speaker.subscribe(() => {\n      const rec = recorderRef.current\n      if (rec === null) return\n      rec.setPaused(false)\n      rec.setInterruptMode(speaker.speaking)\n    })\n  }, [speaker])\n\n  // Drain queued utterances serially: STT -> send -> next (continuous mode).\n  const drain = useCallback(async () => {\n    if (drainRunningRef.current) return\n    drainRunningRef.current = true\n    try {\n      while (queueRef.current.length > 0) {\n        if (recorderRef.current === null) break // user stopped listening\n        const pcm = queueRef.current.shift()!\n        setPhase('transcribing')\n        try {\n          const { text } = await stt(pcm)\n          if (text !== undefined && text.trim() !== '') {\n            await sendText(text.trim())\n          }\n        } catch (err) {\n          console.error('[ui-voice] stt/send failed:', err)\n        }\n      }\n    } finally {\n      drainRunningRef.current = false\n      setPhase(recorderRef.current !== null ? 'listening' : 'idle')\n    }\n  }, [sendText])\n\n  const toggle = useCallback(async () => {\n    if (recorderRef.current !== null) {\n      // Stop: end continuous listening, drop any queued utterances.\n      recorderRef.current.stop()\n      recorderRef.current = null\n      queueRef.current = []\n      setPhase('idle')\n      return\n    }\n\n    // Barge-in: the user is about to speak — cut any reply being read aloud\n    // AND swallow the rest of the current reply (its remaining sentences are\n    // not spoken; the next reply speaks normally).\n    interruptReply()\n\n    const recorder = new MicRecorder({\n      minSilenceMs: 1800,\n      maxUtteranceMs: 30000,\n      rmsThreshold: 0.01,\n      // Noise gate (original project's worklet): -35 dBFS. Tighter than the\n      // original's -45 so louder ambient hums (a desk fan measured ~ -40..\n      // -30 dB) get faded out of the sent stream, while normal speech\n      // (~ -26..-10 dB) passes untouched.\n      noiseGateDb: -35,\n      // Barge-in: bridge silero VAD (real human voice only). RMS values are\n      // the fallback used when the bridge lacks the /api/vad endpoint.\n      vad: new VadStream(),\n      interruptThreshold: 0.06,\n      interruptHoldMs: 250,\n      interruptConfirmMs: 180,\n      onSpeechInterrupt: () => {\n        // The user started talking over the reply: stop it and swallow the\n        // rest; the recorder (now accumulating) turns their speech into the\n        // next utterance automatically.\n        interruptReply()\n      },\n      onSpeakingChange: (speaking) => {\n        setVoiceActive(speaking)\n      },\n      onUtterance: (pcm) => {\n        // Continuous listening: queue the utterance and drain serially.\n        queueRef.current.push(pcm)\n        void drain()\n      },\n    })\n    recorderRef.current = recorder\n    setVoiceActive(false)\n    setPhase('listening')\n    try {\n      await recorder.start()\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.error('[ui-voice] mic start failed:', err)\n      recorder.stop()\n      recorderRef.current = null\n      setVoiceActive(false)\n      setPhase('error')\n    }\n  }, [interruptReply, drain])\n\n  // Hover explanation: current state + its color meaning (no label under the\n  // icon anymore). idle = off, listening+quiet = standby, listening+voice =\n  // recording, transcribing = recognizing, error = unavailable.\n  const statusTitle = phase === 'idle'\n    ? '已关闭（灰）·点击开启聆听'\n    : phase === 'error'\n      ? '不可用（红）·点击重试'\n      : phase === 'transcribing'\n        ? '识别中（深绿）'\n        : voiceActive ? '收音中（绿）' : '待命（蓝）'\n  const className = [\n    chips.chip,\n    css.mic,\n    phase === 'listening' ? css.listening : '',\n    phase === 'transcribing' ? css.transcribing : '',\n    phase === 'error' ? css.error : '',\n    phase === 'listening' && voiceActive ? css.voice : '',\n  ].filter(Boolean).join(' ')\n\n  const phaseColor =\n    phase === 'error'\n      ? 'var(--dsw-alias-state-error-primary)'\n      : phase === 'transcribing'\n        ? 'var(--dsw-alias-state-success-primary)'\n        : phase === 'listening'\n          ? (voiceActive ? 'var(--dsw-alias-state-success-primary)' : 'var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary)')\n          : 'var(--dsw-alias-label-dimmed)'\n\n  return (\n    <span\n      role=\"button\"\n      tabIndex={0}\n      className={className}\n      title={`${t('mic.title')} · ${statusTitle}`}\n      aria-label={`${t('mic.title')} · ${statusTitle}`}\n      style={{\n        display: 'inline-flex',\n        alignItems: 'center',\n        justifyContent: 'center',\n        width: 30,\n        height: 30,\n        padding: 0,\n        border: 'none',\n        borderRadius: 9,\n        cursor: 'pointer',\n        position: 'relative',\n        background: 'rgba(127,127,127,0.14)',\n        color: phaseColor,\n        boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(127,127,127,0.18)',\n        transition: 'color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease',\n      }}\n      onClick={toggle}\n      onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggle() } }}\n    >\n      <MicIcon />\n      <span className={css.waves} aria-hidden=\"true\"><i /><i /><i /></span>\n    </span>\n  )\n})\n"

T6 adds reply TTS playback;\n * T7 the toggles; T8 the companion animation window.\n */\nimport type { ClientContext, SessionId } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/client'\n// Type-only: pulls the locale plugin's Context merge (ctx.locale).\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale/client'\n// Type-only: pulls ui-conversation's SlotMap merge so PropsRuntime resolves.\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client'\nimport { VoiceToolbar } from './VoiceToolbar.tsx'\nimport { BalanceBadge } from './BalanceBadge.tsx'\nimport { ReplySpeakerMount } from './voice/reply-listener.tsx'\nimport { QQBridge } from './voice/qq-bridge.tsx'\nimport { ReplySpeaker } from './voice/speaker.ts'\nimport { CompanionWindow } from './voice/companion.tsx'\nimport { CompanionController } from './voice/companion-controller.ts'\nimport { bridgeBase } from './bridge.ts'\nimport type { VoiceInjected } from './contract.ts'\nimport { en, zh, type VoiceKey } from './locales.ts'\n\ndeclare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots' {\n  interface LocaleNamespaceMap {\n    /** The voice control's copy. */\n    voice: VoiceKey\n  }\n}\n\n/** Dictionary namespace owned by this plugin. */\nconst NS = 'voice'\n\n/** Required services: the slot registry, this plugin's copy, and the sessions service. */\nexport const inject = ['slots', 'locale', 'sessions']\n\n/**\n * Client plugin body: register the `voice` dictionaries and the mic control\n * into the composer tool row (`conversation.input.left`, a list seat beside\n * the resident chrome — never replaces it).       "content": "/**\n * ReplySpeaker: plays synthesized reply WAVs through an AudioContext as a\n * FIFO queue (sentence streaming). `speak()` enqueues; the drain plays one\n * clip at a time and `onended` advances to the next, so sentence N+1 starts\n * the moment N finishes (gaps between clips are tiny). `speaking` stays true\n * while anything is queued or playing, so the companion window and the mic\n * echo-guard follow the whole reply, not individual clips.\n *\n * Interruption: `stop()` halts the current clip and clears the queue; a\n * generation counter discards clips that were queued but not yet started.\n */\nexport class ReplySpeaker {\n  private ctx: AudioContext | null = null\n  private queue: ArrayBuffer[] = []\n  private playing: AudioBufferSourceNode | null = null\n  private drainRunning = false\n  private gen = 0\n  private disposed = false\n  private listeners = new Set<() => void>()\n\n  /** True while a reply is being read (playing or waiting in the queue). */\n  get speaking(): boolean {\n    return this.playing !== null || this.queue.length > 0\n  }\n\n  /** Subscribe to speaking-state changes; returns the unsubscribe function. */\n  subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {\n    this.listeners.add(listener)\n    return () => {\n      this.listeners.delete(listener)\n    }\n  }\n\n  private emit(): void {\n    for (const listener of this.listeners) listener()\n  }\n\n  /** Enqueue one clip for playback (order preserved; plays after earlier clips). */\n  speak(wav: ArrayBuffer): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return\n    this.queue.push(wav)\n    this.emit()\n    void this.drain()\n  }\n\n  private async drain(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.drainRunning) return\n    this.drainRunning = true\n    try {\n      const ctx = this.ctx ?? (this.ctx = new AudioContext())\n      if (ctx.state === 'suspended') {\n        try {\n          await ctx.resume()\n        } catch {\n          // best-effort\n        }\n      }\n      while (this.queue.length > 0 && !this.disposed) {\n        const wav = this.queue.shift()!\n        await this.playOne(ctx, wav)\n      }\n    } finally {\n      this.drainRunning = false\n      this.emit()\n    }\n  }\n\n  private playOne(ctx: AudioContext, wav: ArrayBuffer): Promise<void> {\n    const gen = this.gen\n    return new Promise((resolve) => {\n      void ctx.decodeAudioData(wav)\n        .then((buffer) => {\n          if (this.disposed || gen !== this.gen) {\n            resolve()\n            return\n          }\n          const source = ctx.createBufferSource()\n          source.buffer = buffer\n          source.connect(ctx.destination)\n          this.playing = source\n          this.emit()\n          source.onended = () => {\n            if (this.playing === source) {\n              this.playing = null\n              this.emit()\n            }\n            resolve()\n          }\n          source.start()\n        })\n        .catch(() => resolve())\n    })\n  }\n\n  /** Stop the current clip immediately and clear the queued ones. */\n  stop(): void {\n    this.gen += 1\n    if (this.playing !== null) {\n      try {\n        this.playing.stop()\n      } catch {\n        // already stopped\n      }\n      this.playing = null\n    }\n    this.queue = []\n    this.emit()\n  }\n\n  /** Release the AudioContext (plugin teardown). */\n  dispose(): void {\n    this.disposed = true\n    this.stop()\n    if (this.ctx !== null) {\n      void this.ctx.close().catch(() => {})\n      this.ctx = null\n    }\n    this.listeners.clear()\n  }\n}\n"

DEFAULT_CHUNK_MS;\n    this._inputRate = sampleRate;\n    this._ratio = this._inputRate / TARGET_RATE;\n    this._chunkSamples16k = Math.round((TARGET_RATE * chunkMs) / 1000);\n    this._scratch = new Float32Array(0);\n    this._decimated = new Float32Array(this._chunkSamples16k);\n    this._enabled = true;\n\n    this._gateEnabled = false;\n    this._thresholdLin = 0;\n    this._gateGain = 1;\n    this._holdRemaining = 0;\n    this._attackCoef = Math.exp(-1 / ((GATE_ATTACK_MS / 1000) * TARGET_RATE));\n    this._releaseCoef = Math.exp(-1 / ((GATE_RELEASE_MS / 1000) * TARGET_RATE));\n    this._holdSamples = Math.round((GATE_HOLD_MS / 1000) * TARGET_RATE);\n\n    this.port.onmessage = (e) => {\n      const data = e.data;\n      if (data?.kind === \"enable\") this._enabled = !!data.value;\n      else if (data?.kind === \"gate\") {\n        this._gateEnabled = !!data.enabled;\n        this._thresholdLin = data.enabled ? Math.pow(10, data.thresholdDb / 20) : 0;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  _ingest(incoming) {\n    if (incoming.length === 0) return;\n    const next = new Float32Array(this._scratch.length + incoming.length);\n    next.set(this._scratch, 0);\n    next.set(incoming, this._scratch.length);\n    this._scratch = next;\n    this._maybeEmit();\n  }\n\n  _maybeEmit() {\n    const r = this._ratio;\n    const n = this._chunkSamples16k;\n    const needIn = Math.ceil(n * r);\n    const dec = this._decimated;\n    while (this._scratch.length >= needIn) {\n      let sumSq = 0;\n      if (Math.abs(r - 3) < 1e-6) {\n        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n          const idx = i * 3;\n          const s = (this._scratch[idx] + this._scratch[idx + 1] + this._scratch[idx + 2]) / 3;\n          dec[i] = s;\n          sumSq += s * s;\n        }\n      } else {\n        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n          const srcPos = i * r;\n          const idx = Math.floor(srcPos);\n          const frac = srcPos - idx;\n          const a = this._scratch[idx];\n          const b = this._scratch[idx + 1] ?? a;\n          const s = a + (b - a) * frac;\n          dec[i] = s;\n          sumSq += s * s;\n        }\n      }\n      const rms = Math.sqrt(sumSq / n);\n\n      let target = 1;\n      if (this._gateEnabled) {\n        if (rms >= this._thresholdLin) {\n          this._holdRemaining = this._holdSamples;\n        } else if (this._holdRemaining > 0) {\n          this._holdRemaining -= n;\n        } else {\n          target = 0;\n        }\n      }\n\n      const out = new Int16Array(n);\n      let gain = this._gateGain;\n      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n        const coef = target > gain ? this._attackCoef : this._releaseCoef;\n        gain = target + (gain - target) * coef;\n        const s = dec[i] * gain;\n        const clamped = s < -1 ? -1 : s > 1 ? 1 : s;\n        out[i] = clamped < 0 ? clamped * 0x8000 : clamped * 0x7fff;\n      }\n      this._gateGain = gain;\n\n      const consumed = Math.floor(n * r);\n      this._scratch = this._scratch.slice(consumed);\n\n      this.port.postMessage({ kind: \"level\", rms });\n\n      if (this._enabled) {\n        this.port.postMessage(out.buffer, [out.buffer]);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  process(inputs) {\n    const input = inputs[0];\n    if (!input || input.length === 0 || !input[0]) return true;\n    const mono = input[0];\n    if (mono.length > 0) this._ingest(mono);\n    return true;\n  }\n}\n\nregisterProcessor(\"mic-capture\", MicCaptureProcessor);\n`\n"
